title: [Main]- Edit in Excel insert fails on Price List Lines (Page 7001) — Unit of Measure Code validated before Product No. is set causing NavTestFieldException on Price Asset (Table 7003)
summary: Fixed a bug where inserting price list lines through Edit in Excel failed when a Unit of Measure Code was provided, because validation occurred against empty previous values instead of the current row data.
key_points: Edit in Excel inserts to Price List Lines now validate against the current row values, not stale previous record state
Added IsODataClient() check to distinguish OData requests from other clients
Modified CopyRecTo procedures to use current record for new lines or OData clients
Prevents NavTestFieldException on Price Asset when Unit of Measure Code is set without Product No. being established first
Added unit test UnitOfMeasureCodeOnInsertLineViaOData to verify the fix
